1. A private key generation method for a blockchain electronic wallet based on fingerprint information, comprising: performing image acquisition on a fingerprint of a user; binarizing the fingerprint image to obtain a binarized fingerprint image; extracting fingerprint feature points from the binarized fingerprint image and constructing a feature point set according to all the extracted fingerprint feature points; obtaining a normalized matrix according to the feature point set; and generating a private key corresponding to the fingerprint of the user by using the normalized matrix.

2. The private key generation method according to claim 1, wherein extracting the fingerprint feature points comprises: scanning each pixel in the binarized fingerprint image and selecting a pixel q; computing a classification parameter N using pixel values of eight pixels in an eight-neighborhood pixel map of the pixel q; determining, according to the classification parameter N, whether the pixel is an endpoint or a bifurcation point; denoising the binarized fingerprint image to obtain denoised endpoints and bifurcation points; and constructing the feature point set using the denoised endpoints and bifurcation points.

3. The private key generation method according to claim 2, wherein the pixel q is determined as an endpoint when N equals 1, and as a bifurcation point when N equals 3.

4. The private key generation method according to claim 2, wherein denoising the binarized fingerprint image comprises: starting from an endpoint, moving Z pixels along the ridge on which the endpoint is located, and if a bifurcation point is encountered within the Z pixels, determining the bifurcation point as a noise point and removing it; traversing all endpoints and ridges in the binarized fingerprint image and removing all noise points; wherein Z is an adjustable parameter adjusted according to a size and resolution of the fingerprint image.

5. The private key generation method according to claim 1, wherein obtaining the normalized matrix comprises: assuming that a feature point set Q has k elements, for each element finding two nearest elements and computing Euclidean distances between any two of the three elements; sorting the three Euclidean distances in a preset order to form a distance vector d; forming a two-dimensional distance vector D0 from the distance vectors of the k elements; for each element in D0, summing its three Euclidean distances and sorting the sums in a preset order to form a matrix D of k rows and 3 columns; and normalizing each column of the matrix D to obtain the normalized matrix D.

6. The private key generation method according to claim 5, wherein normalizing each column comprises normalizing each element of the column according to a normalization formula, wherein m equals 1 to k and i equals 2 or 3.

7. The private key generation method according to claim 1, wherein generating the private key comprises: computing, for each element of the normalized matrix, a rounded integer according to a rounding rule, wherein lambda is an adjustable non-negative integer parameter; and arranging the rounded integers in a preset order to generate the private key corresponding to the fingerprint of the user.

8. A private key generation system for a blockchain electronic wallet based on fingerprint information, comprising: an image acquisition module configured to acquire fingerprint information of a user; a binarization module configured to binarize a fingerprint image to obtain a binarized fingerprint image; a set construction module configured to extract fingerprint feature points from the binarized fingerprint image and construct a feature point set; a normalization matrix generation module configured to generate a normalized matrix using elements of the feature point set; and a generation module configured to generate a private key corresponding to the fingerprint of the user by using the normalized matrix.

9. A private key generation apparatus for a blockchain electronic wallet based on fingerprint information, comprising a processor capable of invoking a smart contract from a blockchain, wherein the smart contract comprises a computer program that, when running on the processor, executes the steps of: performing image acquisition on a fingerprint of a user; binarizing the fingerprint image to obtain a binarized fingerprint image; extracting fingerprint feature points from the binarized fingerprint image and constructing a feature point set according to all the extracted fingerprint feature points; obtaining a normalized matrix according to the feature point set; and generating a private key corresponding to the fingerprint of the user by using the normalized matrix.

10. A personal electronic wallet based on blockchain, comprising a private key, wherein the private key is generated by the private key generation method according to any one of claims 1 to 7, and the private key generation method is stored on the blockchain as a smart contract.

1. A visual modeling method for a neural network model, comprising: constructing mapping relationships for each computing method and each object/instance in a deep learning framework, constructing a corresponding visual control for each object/instance, and mapping input-output relationships into visual directed arcs; further comprising: upon receiving an operation on at least one visual control, determining a node set according to the object/instance corresponding to each operated visual control and the mapping relationships; upon receiving an operation on at least one visual directed arc, determining a dependency set according to each operated visual directed arc and the input-output relationships; upon receiving a modeling request, initializing a pre-constructed source code file; and generating a corresponding neural network model based on the deep learning framework and the initialized source code file by using the node set and the dependency set.

2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the visual control comprises graphic shapes and text symbols; and/or mapping the input-output relationships into visual directed arcs comprises mapping the input-output relationships into directed line segments, wherein a model node connected to a starting end of a directed line segment is defined as an input, and a model node connected to a terminating end is defined as an output corresponding to the input.

3. A visual modeling apparatus for a neural network model, comprising: a mapping construction and storage unit, configured to construct mapping relationships for each computing method and each object/instance in an external deep learning framework, construct a corresponding visual control for each object/instance, map input-output relationships into visual directed arcs, and store the mapping relationships, the visual controls and the visual directed arcs; a node set construction unit, configured to, upon receiving an operation on at least one visual control stored by the mapping construction and storage unit, determine a node set according to the object/instance corresponding to each operated visual control and the mapping relationships; a dependency set construction unit, configured to, upon receiving an operation on at least one visual directed arc stored by the mapping construction and storage unit, determine a dependency set according to each operated visual directed arc and the input-output relationships; and a model generation unit, configured to, upon receiving a modeling request, initialize a pre-constructed source code file, and generate a corresponding neural network model based on the external deep learning framework and the initialized source code file by using the node set and the dependency set.
